description: CorePasteboardFlavorType 0x75743136 from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/styled.rtf (a hand-written RTF with bold/italic/both runs, two fonts, a red colour-table entry and one \'e9 accent), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: The same bytes again under the legacy four-char-code name: 0x75743136 is 'ut16'. Byte-identical to the modern UTI's data: AppKit publishes the legacy NSPasteboardType name and the UTI as two names for one representation.
